result.brief: 提出面向光刻工艺窗口恢复的端点世界模型，用因果预测分支对齐图像特征与端点表征，并以条件流策略生成二维校正动作块。
result.reason: Endpoint world model with causal predictive branch aligning image features to endpoint representations plus flow policy for parameter recovery; representation alignment contribution, though domain is lithography SEM.
